title.narrative: To contribute to the development of a diversified and efficient agriculture sector that promotes inclusive green economic growth

description.narrative: Average gross margin is increased for producers in the value chains targeted by the ZAGP; Average profits for processors and other downstream players are increased in the ZAGP targeted value chains; Livestock mortality rates are redcued in ZAGP targeted livestock value chains disaggregated by value chain; Calving rates for beef and dairy cows are increased; Access to markets by value chain players is increased; Average cost of compliance by players in the targeted value chains is reduced; Number of value chain players adopting technologies developed or promoted by the ZAGP disaggregated by type of VC player is increased; Number of livestock producers reporting a reduction in the cost of feed 10% in magnitude is increased; % of variable costs of institutions/organisations established or supported by the ZAGP (ACEs, DACEs, AHMCs, MCCs, BMUs, PBAs) is covered by internally generated and retained income

title.narrative: 1.2: Percentage contribution by the livestock value chains to decent employment in Zimbabwe

description.narrative: The indicator is calculated by summing up the total number of persons decently employed in the livestock value chains and divide by the total number of persons in decent employment in the country and multiply by 100

comment.narrative: These were done in June 2022
